Approval Workflow

Newly registered vendors are assigned an initial Approval Status of Pending. Authorized users can approve or reject vendor registrations after reviewing company information and uploaded documents.

  • Pending → Approved
  • Pending → Rejected
  • Approval actions are recorded for audit purposes.
  • Only authorized users can approve or reject vendors.

Audit Information

FastAPI automatically records approval activities.

  • Approved By
  • Approved Date
  • Rejected By
  • Rejected Date
  • Last Updated By
  • Last Updated Date

Backend Processing

Vendor approval is processed by the FastAPI backend before updating PostgreSQL.

  • Validate vendor exists.
  • Validate user authorization.
  • Update Approval Status.
  • Update Vendor Status according to business rules.
  • Store audit information.
  • Return updated vendor information.

Procurement Integration

Vendors become available in Procurement Management only when:

  • Approval Status = Approved
  • Vendor Status = Active

Pending, Rejected, Suspended and Inactive vendors will not appear during Vendor Assignment in Procurement.

Future Module Integration

Approved vendor information will be reused by the following modules:

  • Procurement Management
  • Vendor Performance
  • Vendor Reliability
  • Reports & Analytics
  • Contract Management
